author: Pavlo
body:
This is pretty much a remake of my first ever map Vultus (http://avicus.net/forums/11d8735d4). I've gone and redesigned every surface in the map, added heaps more detail, and changed the monument locations, so that they are much easier to get. There are now only 2 monuments. I also renamed the map.

Some features:
- Lots of chests with goodies
- XP bottles
- enchanting tables
- Added water )near enchanting tables)
- lots more

I spent a lot of time remaking this and I hope you guys like it!
